defs.def: to use a needle and thread to make stitches in cloth 缝；做针线活
to make, repair or attach sth using a needle and thread 缝制；缝补；缝上
to join or repair sth by sewing 缝合；缝补

ex.s: One thing I had developed an interest in was sewing, so I took a sewing course at a community college.
ex.t: 我培养出的一项兴趣是缝纫，于是我在社区大学报了一门缝纫课。

ex.s: When we handed the list to our nine-year-old daughter, we expected her to choose a toilet or a sewing machine or something similar.
ex.t: 当我们把名单交给我们9岁的女儿时，我们期望她选择一个厕所或缝纫机或类似的东西。

ex.s: For example, it could be"Shanghai Sewing Machines", or"TsingTaoBeerCorporation".Fromthename GROCERY SHOP you would know what the company sells, where SUPER SA they are located, and the name of the product.
ex.t: 例如，它可能是"上海缝纫机",或者"Tsing Tao BeerCorporatation"。从名称GROCERY SHOP中，你会知道公司销售什么，他们所在的SUPER SA，以及产品的名称。

ex.s: You'd follow your mother into the kitchen or sewing room.Inyourgrandparents'time, there was the prospect of doing the same 1o jobfromgraduation until retirement.How times have changed!
ex.t: 你会跟随你的母亲进入厨房或缝纫室。 在你的祖父母的时代，有 做同样1个工作的前景 从毕业到退休。

ex.s: All the hours of sewing were worth it when I saw the look of joy on her face.
ex.t: 所有的时间缝纫是值得的 当我看到她脸上的快乐。

defs.def: to arrange sth in an acceptable way 安排妥贴；办好；使万无一失
